E1.evidence: PR #351 (base 3a82c908b6dba4b784c46106c51ae73ff1e881b8, head 248cb389b122fa94a68578a48e50d4f240df4629, merged 2015-07-28T22:45:12Z) documents the defect: "The transformed quaternion wasn't being passed to set_attitude_target(), resulting in an incorrect attitude setpoint. I've now fixed this issue." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351). Maintainer vooon first disputed it ("I don't see change. `Eigen::Map<>` should place values in q[4] in wxyz, so your code does nothing.", https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351#issuecomment-125763498), then posted a gtest reproducer (TEST(QMAP, eigen_map_storage) mapping Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> onto float q2[4] and checking q2[0]==w) and confirmed: "And it fails. So bug confirmed. But there should be another way to fix Map." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351#issuecomment-125763805). He opened issue #352 "Eigen::Map<Quaternionf> place data in xyzw order instead of wxyz." with body "Found in PR #351." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/352). The PR author reports a flight test: "Yes. Flew with this code yesterday. I've verified that it now behaves the same as release 0.12.0" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351#issuecomment-125707818).

E2.evidence: Step 1: the code that misbehaves is entirely inside the mavros package (mavros/src/plugins/setpoint_attitude.cpp, SetpointAttitudePlugin::send_attitude_target). The only cross-unit interaction implicated by the primary sources is mavros consuming the Eigen3 library API Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> (issue #352 title: "Eigen::Map<Quaternionf> place data in xyzw order instead of wxyz."; vooon: "That issue is surprise to me, because at API level Eigen::Quaternion uses wxyz, so different internal representation is weird." https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/352#issuecomment-125913947). The runtime victim is the unnamed MAVLink flight controller that receives SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET with the wrongly ordered q[4]. Step 2: the minimal resolving change is confined to mavros internal logic. The fix diff touches only mavros/src/plugins/setpoint_attitude.cpp (+8/-1): it adds `float q_transformed[4];` filled with `q_out.w()`, `q_out.x()`, `q_out.y()`, `q_out.z()` and passes `q_transformed` instead of `q` to set_attitude_target (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/commit/248cb389b122fa94a68578a48e50d4f240df4629). Nothing at any boundary changed: the MAVLink SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET packing call, the ROS subscriptions (`~setpoint_attitude/attitude`, `~setpoint_attitude/cmd_vel`, `~setpoint_attitude/att_throttle`) and the Eigen API are unchanged. The broken code at the parent revision 3a82c908 lines 119-121 reads: "// Eigen use same convention as mavlink: w x y z" / "Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> q_out(q);" / "q_out = UAS::transform_frame_enu_ned(Eigen::Quaterniond(tr.rotation())).cast<float>();" and was introduced by commit 411b7e7e1af0bd39273633e0c6f87bea6dcb8a54 ("plugin #71: Implement TF2 listener. Change param names.", 2015-07-10), which replaced the explicit copy in release 0.12.0 (`q[0] = qt.w();` etc.). The follow-up commit 805112a059c4ccb07f2c680c1d1b51e2c2bc3ed6 ("plugin: setpoint_attitude #352: use new helper.") replaced the fix with `UAS::quaternion_to_mavlink(...)`, again internal to mavros. Therefore ineligible: `internal`.

E3.evidence: Recorded for completeness although the case stops at E2. The operation in which the defect manifests is PAIR: mavros's SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET output feeds the flight controller's attitude controller ("Send setpoint attitude/orientation/thrust to FCU controller.", setpoint_attitude.cpp header comment at 3a82c908). LorenzMeier asked for "a system-level verification" and the author flight-tested (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351#issuecomment-125707504, #issuecomment-125707818).

E4.evidence: Outcome stated in the PR: "resulting in an incorrect attitude setpoint" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351); maintainer's gtest for the Map storage order: "And it fails. So bug confirmed." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/351#issuecomment-125763805). No FCU-side log is shown.

ineligible_reason: E2 stop at step 2 (`internal`): the minimal resolving change is confined to mavros's own plugin code (quaternion coefficient order when copying an Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> into the float[4] handed to the MAVLink packer); no declared or referenced interface of any unit changed.
notes: Secondary-source disagreement: the packet's bug_description says the higher-level function "fails to convert the resulting quaternion to the NED frame". The primary source disagrees: at the broken revision 3a82c908 the ENU->NED conversion is already applied (`UAS::transform_frame_enu_ned(...)`, line 121); the defect confirmed by the maintainer is the coefficient order, because Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> stores x,y,z,w in memory while the MAVLink q[4] field and the code comment assume w,x,y,z (issue #352). The primary source is followed.
